default_criteria.description: How well the option supports confirmed business objectives.
How well required user journeys and operational workflows are supported.
Compatibility with verified existing systems and documented interfaces.
Suitability of data handling, access controls, and security architecture.
Risk of losing content, functionality, data, or search visibility.
Ability to operate, support, and update the solution.
Support for accessible and usable customer experiences.
Fit with confirmed budget, timeline, and available resources.

rules: Weights are illustrative defaults and must be reviewed against the customer's priorities.
Rate only criteria supported by sufficient evidence.
Mark unsupported criteria not_assessed; do not silently score them as average.
Normalize scores using assessed weights and disclose the assessed coverage.
Show major trade-offs and evidence gaps alongside any total score.
Never allow a high total score to override a mandatory safety, security, legal, or approval gate.
Do not describe a weighted score as an objective probability of success.
